scope: audit-only; never promotes lexical leads to deployed object profiles or delivery/Unit ownership

reviews.summaryEvidence: This weapon does not use the shared [[weapon:mines|Mines]] placement or triggering rules in either mode.
reviews.caveat: Chest Mine has BS Direct Template and CC attack modes, both drawing on its owner's Disposable (2) uses. Despite its name it is not placed via the Mines/Place Deployable rules and has no independently deployed four-stat profile.

reviews.summaryEvidence: Sepsitor Plus uses the [[trait:direct-template|Direct Template]] rules
factsEvidence: The N5 v5.3 Weapon Chart includes a [*] reference to the N5 Weaponry rules
reviews.caveat: The [*] marker is a printed chart cross-reference, not a battlefield Marker. Sepsitor Plus is a Direct Template attack causing Sepsitorized State; no independent deployed device is described.

reviews.summaryEvidence: Only this mode places a circular [[trait:impact-template|Impact Template]] at the point of impact.
reviews.caveat: Only Blast Mode uses an Impact Template; Hit Mode does not. The attack template resolves the shot, not a persistent independently targetable deployed object, and the two modes share disposable uses.

reviews.summaryEvidence: Template placement, not a range-band modifier, determines the affected area.
reviews.caveat: Chain Rifle's Large Teardrop Direct Template is the attack area, not a targetable deployed item. Do not equate template placement or Intuitive Attack permission with Place Deployable.

Multispectral Visor Level 3 can attack an existing Camouflage Marker in LoF in the Active Turn without a prior Discover Roll; this does not create, place or automatically reveal a separate game object for the army.

reviews.summaryEvidence: Automatic Equipment that lets nearby Allied Troopers reload eligible Disposable items
factsEvidence: Recovering uses does not affect items already deployed on the table.
reviews.caveat: Baggage restores eligible unused/expended uses for existing carriers; it cannot recreate or alter objects already deployed on the battlefield and defines no new deployed device.

reviews.summaryEvidence: Army Equipment identity whose game effect is defined by the [[skill:transmutation]]
factsEvidence: The profile change places an Eclipse Special Ammo Circular Template centered on the replacement Model.
reviews.caveat: N5.3 p.117 Transmutation (Escape System-X) replaces an existing Trooper's Unit Profile/Model and places a temporary Eclipse Template; neither a distinct persistent equipment object nor its carrier is created.

reviews.summaryEvidence: Optional Automatic Equipment that lets its user deploy in or enter [[state:holomask]].
factsEvidence: During Deployment, the user may deploy in [[state:holomask]].
reviews.caveat: N5.3 p.124 Holomask makes an existing Trooper appear as another Model; it does not create a second Trooper or permit copying the imitated Trooper's deployed Weapon/Equipment.

reviews.summaryEvidence: Optional NFB Automatic Equipment that lets its user deploy in or enter [[state:holoecho]].
factsEvidence: When placed on the table, the bearer may deploy in [[state:holoecho]].
reviews.caveat: N5.3 p.124 Holoprojector enables Holoecho State of one existing bearer. Holoecho replicas can trigger Mines and CrazyKoalas under their State rules, but are not independently deployed Weapon/Equipment objects.
